response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced and versatile software craftsman with strong systems and low-latency programming background, but his career has been almost entirely focused on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang ecosystems with minimal recent Java exposure and no evident Kotlin, Spring, or IDE internals experience, making him a weak match for this Java/Kotlin/Spring-focused JVM IDE tooling role.
strengths: Extensive experience across web, embedded, and systems-level programming (10+ years)
Demonstrated ability to own complex projects end-to-end and work with large-scale infrastructure
Strong communication and teaching skills (workshops, talks, open source)
concerns: No recent or substantial Java experience (last significant Java use appears to be 2016-2018 with robotics/mobile tooling)
No mention of Kotlin, Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or JVM-specific tooling
No evidence of IDE internals or language tooling experience relevant to this role

key_factors.factor: No IDE internals or language tooling background
Strong general engineering craftsmanship and adaptability
